intended_object: The canonical equivalence of categories (Cᵒᵖ ⥤ D)ᵒᵖ ≌ (C ⥤ Dᵒᵖ), sending F to F.rightOp, with inverse G ↦ op G.leftOp (from the docstring and name).
explanation: The functor sends F to F.unop.rightOp and natural transformations to their rightOp. The inverse sends G to op G.leftOp and η to η.leftOp.op. The unit and counit are the canonical isomorphisms rightOpLeftOpIso and leftOpRightOpIso. Together these give exactly the standard equivalence between contravariant functors C → D and covariant functors C → Dᵒᵖ. C and D are arbitrary categories with independent universe levels, which is the natural generality, so the definition is faithful.
